caption: Delegation Grant
name: delegation_grant
description: A grant of authority from one party to another, bounded in scope, purpose and time. Recording the grant on the decision is what makes a delegated action attributable to both the delegate and the grantor.

grantor.caption: Grantor
grantor.description: The party whose authority is being exercised.

scope.caption: Scope
scope.description: What the grant covers, expressed in the producer's own scope vocabulary.

on_revoke_in_flight.caption: On Revoke In Flight
on_revoke_in_flight.description: fail | allow_completion. Whether an instruction already accepted but not yet complete fails when authority is withdrawn. Fail is the safe default; allow_completion should be an explicit, recorded election by the grantor.
